description: Lists public CMBS trusts, most distressed first (share of balance delinquent or with the special servicer), optionally filtered by a name fragment such as Benchmark or 2021. Use it to find a trust's slug or to see which deals are most distressed; use get_trust for one deal. No match returns an empty list.

limit.description: Up to 25 free, 400 with a Pro or Team key

name: list_trusts
title: List CMBS trusts
